content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom and media billing and operations software for operators; no travel distribution or booking business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Billing and customer care software for pay-TV and telecom operators; different products and customers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"In-flight connectivity hardware and internet service for aircraft; serves aviation but does not run booking or distribution platforms."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Marketing data connectivity software for brands and advertisers; no travel booking or airline customers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Point-of-sale hardware and payments for restaurants and retailers; different products and merchant customers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Application development, data and infrastructure software for enterprise IT teams; no travel business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"IP communications and session border controller products for telecom carriers; different technology and customers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise customer experience and social media software for brands; no travel distribution or airline customers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Investment management and fund administration software and outsourcing for financial firms; different industry."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Consumer travel reviews and advertising platform; sells to travelers, not the B2B booking distribution Sabre runs for airlines."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Fleet fuel cards, corporate payments and health account administration; payments business, not travel booking."}]}
